actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (20 significant RNA pathways with hypoxia/EMT/coagulation up-regulation, significant CNV shifts including CDKN2A/9p loss). Cross-modal diagnostics show consistently positive boundary separation from all other sets with RNA/CNV driving the distinction, supporting the current membership despite weak internal silhouettes. The only technical association is a CT scanner model, which does not explain the RNA/CNV-based defining signal. Retained for downstream validation with residual uncertainty from weak internal cohesion.

C0002 shows robust coherent multi-modality identity evidence (15 significant RNA pathways with WNT/TGF-beta up-regulation, 19 significant CNV features with coordinated VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 loss, significant chr8p/chr14q/chr3p gain-loss events). Cross-modal structure is moderate (resample ARI 0.65) with positive modality silhouettes and consistently positive boundaries to all other sets. No set-level technical confounder was identified. Retained for downstream validation.

C0003 is defined by a strong, coherent BAP1-mutant signature (q=3.6e-5, OR 26.7) with concordant RNA pathway down-regulation. Cross-modal structure is stable (resample ARI 1.0, PAC 0.31) with consistently positive boundaries to all other sets, WXS/RNA providing the strongest separation. The tissue-source-site association does not explain the WXS mutation signal. Retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has coherent identity evidence centered on significant VHL and PBRM1 depletion (both q=0.0042) plus significant chr1p loss enrichment and chr9q/JAK2 gain, with directionally consistent RNA. Cross-modal boundaries are positive against all other sets, driven largely by WXS. No set-level technical confounder was identified. Retained for downstream validation with residual uncertainty from limited internal cohesion and single-modality dominance.

C0005 lacks significant biological differentiation in any modality; only nominal VHL enrichment and PBRM1 depletion are present, and structure is almost entirely WXS-driven. However, cross-modal boundaries are consistently positive against all other sets and no technical confounder was identified, so the candidate remains defensible at discovery stage. Retained for downstream validation with explicit uncertainty about its biological identity.
